styles.css:
width: auto; min-width: 0px; padding: 0px; display: flex; flex-direction: column; grid-column: 1; grid-row: 1; justify-self: start;
@media(--tablet) { grid-column: 1; justify-self: start; }

font-weight: 600; font-size: 15px; color: #F0F9F7; &:hover { color: #46D7A6; } dropdown { color: #F0F9F7; background-color: #152735; } dropdown:hover { color: #46D7A6; } toggle { color: #F0F9F7; border-radius: 9px; background-color: #152735; }
